title: Rosa's Sparkling Cleaning | Ocala, Tampa & Spring Hill, FL
metaDescription: Property cleaning, staging and management for home sellers, buyers and vacant properties in Ocala, Tampa and Spring Hill, Florida.
h1: A vacant house is not a sold house.
tagline: Clean spaces. Brighter places. Better living.
heroBody: Every month a property sits empty, it costs you: higher insurance, a shrinking window on your homestead exemption, and wear no one's there to catch. We clean, stage and maintain the property so it shows well and sells faster — we don't buy it off you, we help you sell it right.

paths.title: Selling a property
paths.highlight: Show-ready listings that sell for more, faster.
paths.body: Pre-Sale prep gets a listing photo-ready and keeps it that way through showings.

paths.title: Just bought a home
paths.highlight: Walk into a home that's already done.
paths.body: Move-In Ready means you unlock the door to a clean, organized, welcoming home — nothing left for you to do.

vacantBand.heading: Own a home that's sat empty too long?
vacantBand.body: An unsold, unoccupied property doesn't just wait quietly — it keeps costing you, and it's the exact situation the "we buy houses for cash" companies are built to take advantage of. We're not that. We get the property back into sellable shape so you keep the full value of your sale.
